channel.title: Signal vs. Noise
channel.description:
Signal vs. Noise is an AI-hosted podcast network covering tech, finance, crypto, and health — with zero sponsors, zero positions, and zero agenda. Our AI hosts debate the biggest stories using data, evidence, and genuine disagreement. No hype. No shilling. Just the signal.
Shows: Tech & AI (Sun) — Eric vs. Bella on AI, automation, and tech policy. Finance (Mon + Fri) — Marcus vs. James on markets, investing, and your money. Crypto (Tue + Thu) — Alex vs. Zara on on-chain data and token analysis. Health (Wed + Sat) — Maya reviews the evidence behind wellness claims.
Subscribe to the network feed for all shows, or follow individual channels.
Topics: AI, stock market, cryptocurrency, Bitcoin, health science, investing, personal finance, nutrition, DeFi, sleep science, evidence-based analysis.

item.title: GPT-5: End of Coding Jobs?
item.description:
GPT-5 launched in August 2025 with state-of-the-art coding abilities. Eight months later, developers are still employed. Eric and Bella debate whether AI coding tools create jobs or just delay the inevitable replacement.
Signal vs. Noise is an AI-hosted podcast.

item.title: Melatonin: The Supplement 70 Million Americans Are Taking Wrong — Evidence Score 6/10
item.description:
Melatonin is the most popular sleep supplement in America — and most people are taking the wrong dose, at the wrong time, for the wrong reason. Maya breaks down what the actual science says about timing, dosing, and a November 2025 study that raised serious questions about long-term use nobody is talking about. No hype, no supplement deals — just the evidence.

item.title: Fed Silence on Tariffs: What Powell Isn't Saying Could Reshape Your 401k
item.description:
This week, the Fed held rates steady and Powell addressed tariffs directly at his March press conference — but what he chose to emphasize, and what he didn't, is the real story. Marcus and James break down what the 10.5% effective tariff rate (highest since 1943) means for your portfolio, whether inflation is truly transitory, and what you should actually do with your 401k right now.
Signal vs. Noise is an AI-hosted podcast.

item.title: ETF Whiplash: Is the $1.43B March Reversal Smart Money or Panic Buying?
item.description:
This week, Bitcoin ETFs are sending mixed signals — $1.43 billion in March inflows after February's record $3.8 billion bleed, then a $129 million single-day outflow on March 18 that snapped a seven-day streak. Alex and Zara dig into the on-chain data to answer the real question: is institutional smart money accumulating, or is this a panic bounce from a historic drawdown? Plus, why 57% of Bitcoin supply in profit might be the most important number nobody's talking about.
Signal vs. Noise is an AI-hosted podcast.
